acceptanceCriteria: Retain an owner-accepted disposition for the newly generated coverage.governance_refused relation/trust values against CCF-V1-005/006; distinguish a rollback to additive warnings from an explicitly accepted freeze amendment.
Preserve hidden-Unicode and self-modified-authority warnings, fail-closed governance exclusion, and clean-packet compatibility; bind focused regression tests to the chosen disposition.
Retain independent review, exact CEM/OCM bindings and verification, then integration and native completion evidence; do not treat PR467 merge as acceptance of the frozen values.
body: Confirmed source/contract discrepancy at merged PR467, commit 93fda492e999f3078e412c0fad093892ddcf7ce4. internal/contextindex/trust.go:92-108 now emits coverage.governance_refused for downgraded rows, including relation, path, trust=repository-content, reason and warnings. docs/specs/core-compatibility-freeze-v1.md:280-292 still records relation/trust as NOT_PRODUCED because no generator writes a row and requires CCF-V1-006 review before registering a value. PR467 body and docs/build-log/2026-10-01-governing-unicode-screen.md explicitly retain this owner follow-up; merger is not evidence of owner acceptance. Reproduction: read those exact files at the immutable merge and run existing TestTaskContextDowngradesAGoverningFileHidingUnicode, whose assertions expect the new refusal row. Expected: frozen relation/trust semantics have accepted governing authority before production, or warnings remain additive without the new refusal values. Actual: merged generator produces values while the freeze still says none are produced. No runtime test or mutation rerun was made in this filing; semantic wire reproduction is evidenced by original code and test assertions, not claimed as a new run. Installed Core 1.0.0-rc.1 build163 and Tasks 0.0.0-tcp01-unverified+build.202; both match latest applicable official channels checked during this batch. User keeps PR456/458 paused; active V1-0632 reservation covers docs/CEM, so no conflicting repair was started. Recommended disposition from prior handoff: stop writing the new refusal rows and preserve additive warnings, unless the owner explicitly accepts/registers the frozen values. Raw immutable source and merged diff retained in /private/tmp/corvint-codex-batch.S53nDh/{ccf-pr467.md,trust-pr467.go,pr467.json,pr467.diff}. Prior handoff says PR467 was merged while HOLD-OWNER; that assertion is retained as reported, not independently established here. Dedup native export and targeted governance_refused/467 search found no dedicated equivalent ticket; V1-0414 remains the originating partial capability ticket.
title: PR467 authority screen emits frozen governance_refused values without retained owner acceptance
